# Gridopoly build photos

Real prototype photos supplied by the project author on October 16, 2026.
The photographs are preserved as supplied; README labels and captions explain the parts without altering the hardware shown.

- `gridopoly-16-tile-board.jpg`: the 12-long-tile / 4-corner prototype on the workbench.
- `gridopoly-pcbs-and-base.jpg`: connected tile PCBs on a printed corner fixture.
- `gridopoly-player-console-and-power.jpg`: player screen, power PCB and battery during development.
- `gridopoly-rfid-piece.jpg`: pink printed figure above a black RFID tag.

These are build-log images, not assembly drawings. Use the hardware and mechanical documentation for the current revision and assembly instructions.
